text: {"lessons":["I should assess each stock on its future prospects, not cling to its purchase price; reluctance to admit a mistake can prolong a poor investment.","Taking profits in Stock B and Stock D felt rewarding, but I should sell based on the investment outlook rather than the satisfaction of locking in gains.","I sold Stock C at steep losses in two periods; painful as it is, I should review whether the reasons for holding still stand instead of letting loss aversion dictate my decisions."]}
